title: Slovakian Oven-Fried Cheese Casserole
description: A traditional Slovakian dish with a crunchy top and melted cheese center. Perfect for a comforting dinner.
instructions: In a large skillet, sauté the diced onion in butter until softened.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and milk.
Add cubed bread and cheese to the egg mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the bread mixture to a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top with the sautéed onion mixture and dot with butter.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
